subject: expression: remove `SetInNullRejectCheck` in `BuildContext` (#52721)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff and minimal surrounding callers: it removes the mutable `SetInNullRejectCheck` flag from `expression/context.BuildContext`, makes session `IsInNullRejectCheck()` always return false, and introduces an explicit wrapper (`exprctx.WithNullRejectCheck`) exposed via `PlanContext.GetNullRejectCheckExprCtx()` for planner-only use in `isNullRejected` (outer join simplification). The new approach eliminates shared mutable state and keeps null-reject-check behavior scoped to `isNullRejected`, with no apparent correctness/SQL-semantics/concurrency regression in the touched expression/planner paths.
